title: HackerRank: Migratory Birds
description: Given an array of bird sightings `arr` where each element represents a bird type id, determine the id of the most frequently sighted type. If more than 1 type has been spotted that maximum amount, return the smallest of their ids.
constraints:
5 <= len(arr) <= 2 * 10^5, types 1..5
• Time: O(N) | Space: O(1)
explanation: Fixed array tracking bird frequencies 1..5 breaks ties by picking the lowest index in O(N) time.
